subject: music
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: Which instrument is most associated with traditional Irish folk music?
questions.explain: The tin whistle and fiddle are staples of traditional Irish folk music.

questions.q: The sitar and tabla are instruments used in which tradition?
questions.explain: The sitar (plucked strings) and tabla (drums) are central to Indian classical music.

options: Blends elements of two or more musical styles
questions.explain: Fusion combines features of two or more different musical styles or traditions.

questions.q: A recurring musical theme linked to a character, place or idea in film or opera is a:
questions.explain: A leitmotif is a recurring theme associated with a character, place or idea.
The djembe is a West African goblet-shaped hand drum.

questions.q: Film composers often use a loud, sudden chord or sound to make the audience jump. This creates:
questions.explain: Sudden loud stabs build tension, shock or fear in film music.

questions.q: Samba music originates from which country?
questions.explain: Samba is a lively percussion-driven music and dance from Brazil.

questions.q: The steel pan (steel drum) is a tuned percussion instrument from:
questions.explain: The steel pan originated in Trinidad and is central to Caribbean music.

questions.q: In an Indian raga, the continuous sustained background pitch is called the:
questions.explain: A drone is the continuous sustained pitch underpinning Indian classical music, often on a tambura.

questions.q: In African drumming and gospel, a leader plays a phrase and the group answers. This is called:
questions.explain: Call and response is a leader-and-group exchange common in African and gospel music.

options: The loudest moment of a film
Background music played under dialogue or action to set mood
questions.explain: Underscoring is background music played beneath the action or dialogue to create mood.

questions.q: In Indian classical music, the rhythmic cycle is known as the:
questions.explain: The tala is the repeating rhythmic cycle, while the raga is the melodic framework.
